content: Check-in is from 15:00 to 21:00. Please bring a photo ID.
Check-out is by 11:00. Please return the room key to the front desk.
No. 18 Seaside Lane, Qijin District, Kaohsiung. 高雄市旗津區海岸巷18號。
Please call 07-555-0188. The front desk answers from 08:00 to 21:00.
One free car parking space is available for each room. Please tell us your license plate at check-in.
Breakfast is served from 07:30 to 09:30 in the first-floor dining room. Vegetarian breakfast is available with one day's notice.
We accept cash, credit cards, and mobile payment. A 30% deposit is required to confirm a reservation.
Small pets are welcome only in the Garden Twin Room. Please tell us before arrival; a NT$500 cleaning fee applies.
We can store luggage free of charge on your check-in and check-out dates from 08:00 to 21:00.
For a refund, cancel at least 7 days before check-in. For a booking change or an exception, please contact the front desk.
Free Wi-Fi is available in every room. The password is given at check-in.
